subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should this Microsoft tracker and PR-body updating generator live in OpenClaw main as a repo-maintained admin tool, or remain PR-body/comment metadata outside the source tree?
rationale: The PR adds a new maintainer tracking and GitHub mutation workflow, and repo policy makes admin automation and changelog ownership intentional maintainer surfaces rather than routine contributor fixes.

options.title: Sponsor the admin tool after repairs
options.body: Keep the PR open, fix the review blockers, require proof, and merge only after a maintainer accepts the tracker as a source-owned workflow.

options.title: Keep tracking outside main
options.body: Continue using PR bodies, comments, searches, or project views for the Microsoft tracker without adding a root Markdown file and generator to the repository.

options.title: Close the tracker direction
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want a source-owned Microsoft tracker workflow after the issue purge.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the admin tool after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, fix the review blockers, require proof, and merge only after a maintainer accepts the tracker as a source-owned workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: Root ownership and recent scripts/admin history make this the best available owner for the repository-level workflow choice.
